name: app-problem-and-solution-orbit-diagram-with-red-and-green-petals
title: Problem and solution slide with a white sphere wrapped by red and green petal segments
whatItIs: A light grey slide with a headline and paragraph with highlighted phrases, a soft white sphere with two red petal segments numbered 01 and 02 and one green segment 03, red connector labels 'Problem 1/2' with 68% and 36% stats and a green dot leading to a 'Solution' heading and paragraph.
whatItMeans: Clear and memorable; the sphere makes problems and the solution one object.
techniques: Represent problems and solution as segments of a sphere.
Colour problems red and the solution green.
Connect with thin elbow lines to labels.
Show big percentages beside each problem.

vocabulary.definition: A curved segment wrapping a sphere.
Red for problems, green for solutions.
A pill linked by a thin line.
A big percentage with a caption.
